plan.notes: Official Catalog Year 2026-27 pathway map ('Course Sequence by Term', Full-time sequence) from Phoenix College. Terms are the college's own suggested sequence; full-time status is 12-18 credits per semester. Credit ranges (e.g. 3-6, 1-3, 0-3) are summed at their minimum in total_credits. The AAS in Information Technology is offered in 10 specialization tracks (Cybersecurity Fundamentals, Database Development, Desktop Support, Foundations of Mobile App Development, Microsoft Office Professional, Microsoft Server, Oracle Database Operations, Programming and Systems Analysis Level 1, Redhat Linux Engineer, Web Foundations); this seed sequences the first-listed track, Cybersecurity Fundamentals. The page also lists a 'Related Area Courses' requirement (select courses by prefix to complete a minimum of 61 credits) that is not term-assigned and is not sequenced here. Coordinator remediation 2026-10-01 (source-verified mechanical fixes; see merge/REMEDIATION-LOG.md).
